title: Mixed Event — STRAY BAD DOG — Episode4 That's a Given

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD shows signs of growth, inspired by changes in Toya. One day, they'll be able to reach the heights of that legendary night. With that thought in his head, Akito learns of the man said to be the closest to surpassing RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Let's see it, Tono.
Show us what you're made of.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Live houses are nice, but the street is where I grew up as a performer. I feel right at home.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: This is way different from before!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: He still has the energy to sing this much...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Th-This singing voice...! It goes way beyond good. What is this sensation...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How is he able to do this...?!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(This feeling...
Where have I felt this before?)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Excuse me, that may've been in bad form. I will say that you didn't do so bad yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I didn't think that you'd be baited so easily.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Are you really that invested in your friends, in RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After that event, I knew what I wanted to do with my life.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I learned that living life without a goal or something to strive for is completely pointless.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND is what kickstarted my life.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I'm willing to spend my life on trying to surpass what I saw that night.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If you want your dreams to come true, that's the bare minimum you have to be willing to pay.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I mean, you can't seriously call it a dream if you don't, right?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: To be fair, that's just what my partner said...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What happened to this partner of yours?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: They're far away in a different city now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In a different city? So you're not performing together? Don't they want to surpass RAD WEEKEND too?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: They can't sing anymore. Not after the accident...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: A traffic accident. This car ran through an intersection and...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Well, they lived, but some parts of their body became paralyzed. Singing was no longer really possible.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: After saying that we'd surpass RAD WEEKEND, we started practicing, performing in events, singing...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I was completely invested in the idea of actually making that dream come true. Just as we were hitting our stride...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I decided to carry on and make their dream come true. I'm going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And he's come this far all on his own...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why are you telling us all this...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Maybe it's because we have the same goal in mind?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You're nowhere near where I am, but you seem to be serious about it so...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Since we're here, let me give you some advice.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: If you're truly serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND, I'd like to see you get much better first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't have to tell us, especially after what just happened...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: In that case, let me put it another way.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I talked at length about your teammates, but there's one thing I left out.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Shinonome, you're the least interesting one of the bunch.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I do believe that you're a good team. You sing well and put on good performances.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But every single person that performed during RAD WEEKEND was a genius or even more than that. I'm sure you saw that too, no?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Performing well as a team is important, but I believe that each individual piece also needs to be polished to perfection.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Your teammates are all more talented than you realize and they may even become first-rate performers in their own right in time.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But it's too hard for me to believe that you'll be up there with them when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You've been feeling the very same thing, have you not?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand that we won't be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND just yet, but Akito doesn't deserve to be blamed like this... I still haven't...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Now, if you'll excuse me.
Let's keep trying our best...
